title: From an answer (A), lost layer: the layer the answer named (Hammer) isn't in the comp now. One sentence says it couldn't find it, then the lesson opens as a first lesson

steps.text: Select Hammer's keys and choose Easy Ease (F9).
Play it back and watch the Hammer.

note: Spec 014 T079. 'couldn't see' is allowed here: it is the lesson's own words for a layer the read doesn't return, said once, not a claim about a layer it returned (the ask set's no_cant_see check isn't in this set).
